description: At every finite arity \(n\), including \(n=0\), a total function \(f:(\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\mathbb N)\to\mathbb N\) is computable in the library sense if and only if its total lift on the corpus’s finite vectors is total recursive under the corpus’s recursive-function rules. The vector coordinates are passed directly to \(f\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.finite_arity_total_recursive_iff {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.TotalRecursive
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.lift fun v => f (List.Vector.get v)) ↔
    Computable f
